Provenance.drafts: Every hero/smith render is a COMPOSITE, never a single clean generation: stage-1 t2i base (SDXL base 1.0 + pixel-art-xl LoRA @1.0/1.0, 30 steps, cfg 7.0, dpmpp_2m/karras, 832x1216, batch of 4) picks one candidate; some classes then get a stage-2 region-masked inpaint (SetLatentNoiseMask, denoise 0.5, same sampler/scheduler) to fix a specific defect (shield shape, missing daggers, horn/shadow-face detail); vanguard and sentinel additionally got a cast2 torso-only recolor inpaint (denoise 0.5) because both shipped the first round in a pale steel-gray that failed the sim's own ClassDefinition.ColorRgb identity check (measured hue-angle separation 135 degrees vs the hand sprites' 76 degrees) -- see tools/art/gen_town_sprites.py's CLASS_HUES table (~line 218) for the pinned hue each class recolor targeted. Every walk frame then freezes the torso to the adopted base's own bytes above a measured leg_row and composites in leg art below it (a separate contact-pose render for the two weight-bearing frames, a same-render +-1px leg/hem sway for the two passing frames on non-robed classes; robed classes have no visible legs and use a same-render +-1px hem sway only, no extra diffusion sample). All rejected candidates are kept MISS-prefixed under the job's own _work/ folders.
